name: Workspaces per monitor
author: kimm-stensborg
description: Pins workspaces to monitors and shows each monitor's own workspaces in its bar

barWidget.description: Workspace indicators filtered to the monitor the bar is on

schema.label: Show
schema.description: own: only this monitor's workspaces. all: every workspace, grouped, with this monitor's group lit.

schema.label: Group separators
schema.description: Draw a divider between monitor groups (only used when Show is 'all').
